title: Two-fifths-power space simulation for one writable tape
exact_target: For deterministic machines with one writable tape and head, finitely many read-only input heads moving by unit steps from fixed origins, cap-independent symbol functions and the prescribed local-access condition, can the finite-control and halting outcome by binary time cap T be simulated in $\widetilde O(T^{2/5})$ workspace bits, excluding read-only input storage, with unrestricted simulation time and no requirement to materialize the final tape?

sources.citation: OpenAI, manuscript citation page. Source of the formulation motivating this local problem.
